name: Move ClickHouseDB Data to Amazon Redshift
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select **ClickHouse** as the data source.
2.  Select your added **Redshift** data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Add DataBase details - Host, Username, Password, Port, and DB Name to add Credentials.
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/clickhouse/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
